top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a quantitative, falsifiable prediction (flat bands at a magic twist angle, Bistritzer-MacDonald) that experiment confirmed with the discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, since reproduced by independent groups and extended to a whole class of moire systems. The citation can be worded around the prediction and the observed phases, so it does not depend on the open pairing mechanism. The residual weaknesses are credit (Jarillo-Herrero is the only experimental name) and the still-evolving interpretation; P002 (Katori, Ye) is the cleaner, more settled fallback but a narrower, enabling-measurement achievement, and both rank above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P002; documented ties are to PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+ and XL-Calibur, not to the credited names
